notes.title: Chapter 2 Release and Patch notes;
notes.notes:
Chapter 2 has introduced the latest installment of Nox's adventure after the eternal banishment in the coffee shop.



 Play through fully interactable coffee shop, fulfilling coffee orders and the quick demands.
 Complete unique orders with Cream, Amphithere Blood, Sugar and Nectar!
 Don't forget to top off your coffee with a Chocolate, Caramel or Whip Cream Drizzle!
 Interact with new characters and investigate in the Stygian Keep 


Play through an entirely new overhauled art implementation!

We have also added in full animations for all the characters currently in the game that include:

 Full Skulliver Emotion Animations
 Full Grim Emotion Animations
 Animated Cutscenes 
 Animated backgrounds


Misc. Changes:

Updated Map Evidence Minigame which includes Skulliver telling the player the rearrangement of sticky note clues.
Updated and added new sections to the Gallery upon completion for chapter 2

Welcome to Your Never Ending Coffee Shift!

Summary

After the events of the courthouse, Nox has been introduced to his new eternal damnation. In this new realm, he encounters an array of new faces, each with their own sinister stories, and familiar ones who share in his torment. As he navigates this eerie yet beautiful landscape, Nox must confront the consequences of his past actions and the characters that populate his personal hell.

Brew up your coffee starting July 14th 2024!
